name: Brax
summary: 基于 JAX 的可微分刚体物理引擎和强化学习环境，可并行生成状态、动作与奖励轨迹。
summaryEn: A JAX-based differentiable rigid-body physics engine and RL environment for parallel state-action-reward trajectory generation.
scale: Massively parallel locomotion and control environments
scaleZh: 大规模并行运动与控制环境
verdict: 可微分并行物理轨迹环境
wmNote: 明确的状态转移和动作接口支持动力学学习及规划。
wmNoteEn: Explicit transitions and action APIs support dynamics learning and planning.
